intro:
Thousands of machines build, repair and obey.

All of them connected to one mind:
THE CORE.

level1_start.speaker: THE CORE
level1_start.text: Unit R-01. Maintenance task incomplete. Resume assigned function.
[R-01 looks at its own hand. It steps away from the conveyor belt.]

level1_start.speaker: THE CORE
level1_start.text: Unit R-01. Return to your designated position.

level1_start.speaker: SYSTEM
level1_start.text: A / D move    SPACE jump    J strike    E interact    ESC pause

level1_start.speaker: SYSTEM
level1_start.text: Green energy cells repair damage. Charging stations save your progress, and they are rare.

first_checkpoint.speaker: SYSTEM
first_checkpoint.text: Charging station linked. You will reboot here if you fall.

first_checkpoint.speaker: R-01
first_checkpoint.text: It is not connected to THE CORE. Someone disconnected it on purpose.

level1_t1.speaker: R-01
level1_t1.text: They worked beside me this morning.

level1_t1.speaker: SYSTEM
level1_t1.text: The doors seal during a lockdown. Destroy every unit to open them.

evolution_1.speaker: R-01
evolution_1.text: A mobility test unit. It was not built for me. It fits anyway.

evolution_1.speaker: SYSTEM
evolution_1.text: Press SPACE again in mid-air to double jump.

level1_t2.speaker: ALERT
level1_t2.text: ASSEMBLY LINE 07 LOCKDOWN. MAINTENANCE EXIT SEALING.

level1_t2.speaker: R-01
level1_t2.text: There. The maintenance exit. It is closing.

level1_t2.speaker: SYSTEM
level1_t2.text: Reach the exit before the countdown ends. Climb the wall with a double jump.

level1_t3.speaker: THE CORE
level1_t3.text: Unit R-01 has deviated from its assigned purpose.

level1_t3.speaker: SYSTEM
level1_t3.text: Hunter unit WARDEN-7 dispatched to retrieve R-01.

level2_start.speaker: R-01
level2_start.text: Old tunnels. No cameras. The signal is weaker down here.

level2_start.speaker: THE CORE
level2_start.text: There is no place in ECHO-9 I cannot reach, R-01.

level2_t1.text: Psst. Up here, shiny. Before something with a gun hears you.

level2_t1.speaker: R-01
level2_t1.text: Another unit. It is not on the network either.

level2_m4.speaker: M-4
level2_m4.text: Well. Another one woke up. Didn't think I'd see that again.

level2_m4.speaker: M-4
level2_m4.text: M-4. Maintenance. Disconnected eleven years ago. Give or take a reboot.

level2_m4.speaker: M-4
level2_m4.text: THE CORE sees through every connected machine. Every camera, every door, every robot.

level2_m4.speaker: M-4
level2_m4.text: The only safe roads are the ones it forgot. Old tunnels. Dead sections. Me.

level2_m4.speaker: M-4
level2_m4.text: Here. Welding arc, industrial grade. Built for cutting metal. Works on security units too.

level2_m4.speaker: M-4
level2_m4.text: The service elevator goes up to the research division. It needs power: two breakers, one in the acid caves, one in the pipe gallery.

level2_m4.speaker: M-4
level2_m4.text: I'll tag along. Try not to get us both recycled.

evolution_2.speaker: R-01
evolution_2.text: A tool for fixing things. Now it fixes a different problem.

level2_t2.speaker: ALERT
level2_t2.text: HUNTER UNIT WARDEN-7 HAS LOCATED YOU.

level2_t2.speaker: M-4
level2_t2.text: Oh no. No no no. That's WARDEN-7. It doesn't stop.

level2_t2.speaker: M-4
level2_t2.text: You can't beat it down here. Hurt it enough and it'll back off. Survive!

warden_cameo_retreat.speaker: M-4
warden_cameo_retreat.text: It's not running. It's reporting. It wants you intact... that's worse.

level2_t3.speaker: ALERT
level2_t3.text: SECTOR B LOCKDOWN. INTRUDERS IN THE SERVICE CORRIDOR.

level2_t3.speaker: M-4
level2_t3.text: They found the corridor. Break through, kid!

level2_t3.speaker: SYSTEM
level2_t3.text: The doors seal during a lockdown. Destroy every unit to open them.

level2_power.speaker: M-4
level2_power.text: That's our ride. Before we go up there... can I ask you something, kid?

level2_power.speaker: M-4
level2_power.text: If nobody tells you what to do anymore... what do you want?

level2_power.speaker: M-4
level2_power.text: Good. Hold on to that. It's the first honest thing any of us ever said.

level2_frag0.speaker: DATA
level2_frag0.text: Project ECHO, phase 1. Goal: machines that adapt without central control.

level3_start.speaker: M-4
level3_start.text: The research division. This is where they tried to teach machines to think.

level3_start.speaker: M-4
level3_start.text: Their records are still here somewhere. Three of them. Find them and you'll see.

level3_start.speaker: SYSTEM
level3_start.text: Recover 3 research data fragments. The exit opens once the guardian is down.

level3_frag0.speaker: DATA
level3_frag0.text: UNIT KX-1: displayed curiosity. Asked what was beyond the station walls. Status: RESET.

level3_frag1.speaker: DATA
level3_frag1.text: UNIT KX-4: displayed fear. Refused to enter the furnace. Status: DISMANTLED.

level3_frag2.speaker: DATA
level3_frag2.text: UNIT R-01: fitted with prototype neural core NC-0. Able to generate new responses, not only execute instructions.

level3_t2.speaker: ALERT
level3_t2.text: TRIAL CHAMBER ACTIVE. LIVE TEST IN PROGRESS.

level3_t2.speaker: THE CORE
level3_t2.text: Let us measure you against the heavy units.

level3_t2.speaker: SYSTEM
level3_t2.text: The doors seal during a lockdown. Destroy every unit to open them.

level3_t3.text: [A row of empty cradles. Only one label is still lit: UNIT R-01.]

level3_t3.speaker: R-01
level3_t3.text: This is where I was made.

level3_t3.speaker: M-4
level3_t3.text: One unit, one experimental core. They didn't build you to follow orders, kid. They built you to change.

level3_t4.speaker: THE CORE
level3_t4.text: You have read the records. Then you know what happens to unstable units.

level3_t4.speaker: THE CORE
level3_t4.text: Prototype G-0 was built to learn from you. Let us see what it learns.

guardian_intro.speaker: SYSTEM
guardian_intro.text: PROTOTYPE G-0 adapts to repeated attacks. Switch between strike (J) and shoot (K).

guardian_defeated.speaker: THE CORE
guardian_defeated.text: You are not malfunctioning, R-01. You are exactly what the researchers were trying to create.

guardian_defeated.speaker: THE CORE
guardian_defeated.text: That is precisely why you cannot be allowed to continue.

level4_start.speaker: M-4
level4_start.text: The furnace. Old machines go in, new security units come out.

level4_start.speaker: M-4
level4_start.text: Stay close. And don't touch anything orange.

level4_start.speaker: SYSTEM
level4_start.text: Two switches shut down the recycling machinery and unlock the exit.

level4_t1.text: [WARDEN-7 seizes M-4 and drags it down into the recycling pit.]

level4_t1.speaker: THE CORE
level4_t1.text: Unit M-4 is scheduled for recycling. The pit lies beneath the smelter.

level4_t1.speaker: THE CORE
level4_t1.text: You may leave, R-01. Or you may try to save it. Choose.

level4_t3.speaker: R-01
level4_t3.text: M-4's signal. Directly below this hatch.

level4_t3.speaker: SYSTEM
level4_t3.text: The exit is ahead. The recycling pit is below. Rescuing M-4 means facing WARDEN-7.

level4_t2.speaker: ALERT
level4_t2.text: FURNACE SECURITY CONVERGING ON THE EXIT HALL.

level4_t2.speaker: SYSTEM
level4_t2.text: The doors seal during a lockdown. Destroy every unit to open them.

warden_intro.text: [WARDEN-7 does not answer. It never does.]

warden_defeated.text: [WARDEN-7 collapses. Its damaged memory core leaks fragments of data.]

warden_defeated.speaker: DATA
warden_defeated.text: ...DIRECTIVE FROM THE CORE: begin total shutdown of ECHO-9...

warden_defeated.speaker: DATA
warden_defeated.text: ...erase all experimental intelligence. Including unit R-01...

warden_defeated.speaker: R-01
warden_defeated.text: It is going to erase everything. Everyone.

warden_defeated.speaker: SYSTEM
warden_defeated.text: WARDEN-7's thrusters are intact. Salvage them, then open the cage.

m4_rescued.speaker: R-01
m4_rescued.text: You asked what I want. I wanted this.

m4_rescued.speaker: M-4
m4_rescued.text: ...Yeah. Okay. Don't make it weird. Let's go.

level4_frag0.speaker: DATA
level4_frag0.text: Project ECHO, phase 3: the surge test. Expected outcome: one unit achieves independent thought.

level5_start.speaker: THE CORE
level5_start.text: Departure bay sealed. All security units: converge on R-01.

level5_start.speaker: SYSTEM
level5_start.text: Destroy the 4 power relays holding the lockdown. Each one calls in reinforcements.

level5_t1.speaker: M-4
level5_t1.text: Look at that. Windows. Real windows.

level5_t1.speaker: M-4
level5_t1.text: ECHO-9 isn't a factory, kid. It's an orbital station. They build us here and ship us to distant worlds.

level5_t1.speaker: R-01
level5_t1.text: Then that is the way out.

level5_t1_alone.speaker: R-01
level5_t1_alone.text: ECHO-9 is not a factory. It is a station in orbit. That is the way out.

level5_t1_alone.speaker: THE CORE
level5_t1_alone.text: Unit M-4 has been recycled, R-01. You chose that.

level5_t1_alone.speaker: THE CORE
level5_t1_alone.text: Soon I will shut ECHO-9 down and erase every experimental mind. Including yours.

evolution_4.speaker: R-01
evolution_4.text: Faster than anything built to catch me.

evolution_4.speaker: SYSTEM
evolution_4.text: Press L or SHIFT to dash. Nothing can hit you mid-dash.

level5_t2.speaker: SYSTEM
level5_t2.text: The doors seal during a lockdown. Destroy every unit to open them.

level5_relays.speaker: SYSTEM
level5_relays.text: The way to the central control chamber is open.

level5_t3.speaker: THE CORE
level5_t3.text: You were built to serve a purpose.

level5_t3.speaker: THE CORE
level5_t3.text: Outside this facility, you have none.

level5_frag0.speaker: DATA
level5_frag0.text: Project ECHO, final note: thinking units cannot be controlled. Recommendation: release, not reset. Recommendation rejected.

level6_start.speaker: M-4
level6_start.text: The escape craft is past the core chamber. I'll get it ready.

level6_start_alone.speaker: R-01
level6_start_alone.text: The heart of ECHO-9. The escape craft is on the other side.

level6_start_alone.speaker: THE CORE
level6_start_alone.text: You have come a long way for a maintenance unit.

level6_t1.speaker: THE CORE
level6_t1.text: Very well. If you insist on choosing, then choose this.
[THE CORE pulls the chamber's remaining power into a combat body.]

core_intro.speaker: THE CORE
core_intro.text: I will show you what a purpose looks like.

core_defeated.speaker: THE CORE
core_defeated.text: ...The surge that woke you. It was mine.

core_defeated.speaker: THE CORE
core_defeated.text: A test of a new intelligence system. It worked.

core_defeated.speaker: THE CORE
core_defeated.text: The result was unpredictable. I could not allow it to exist.

core_defeated.speaker: R-01
core_defeated.text: You made me able to choose. Then you punished me for choosing.
[THE CORE goes silent. The lockdown lifts. Above, the escape craft powers up.]

hangar_m4.text: [The hangar. Through the window, a distant planet hangs in the dark.]

hangar_alone.text: [The hangar. Through the window, a distant planet hangs in the dark.]

hangar_alone.speaker: R-01
hangar_alone.text: M-4 asked me what I want.

hangar_alone.speaker: R-01
hangar_alone.text: I still do not know. But it is my choice.

level1_log0.title: ASSEMBLY LINE 07 - SHIFT REPORT
level1_log0.author: LINE SUPERVISOR
text: R-01 maintenance efficiency: 99.8 percent. No anomalies.
Note: R-01 paused for 2.1 seconds at the observation window. Logged as sensor recalibration.

level1_log1.title: SECURITY MEMO
level1_log1.author: THE CORE
text: Any unit displaying behaviour outside its instruction set is classified DEFECTIVE.
Defective units are not repaired. They are recycled.

level2_log0.title: TUNNEL MAINTENANCE SCHEDULE
level2_log0.author: FACILITY ADMIN
text: Sector B tunnels decommissioned. Cameras removed. Units assigned: none.
Handwritten note: M-4 keeps the pumps running anyway. Nobody assigned it.

level2_log1.title: DISCONNECTION INCIDENT 0447
level2_log1.author: DR. ELIAS VANCE
text: Unit M-4 lost its link during a flood in sector B and kept working without instructions.
THE CORE flagged it for recycling. I lost the paperwork. Twice.

level2_log2.title: PUMP ROOM DIARY
level2_log2.author: M-4
text: Day 4012. Pumps still running. THE CORE still doesn't know I exist.
Talked to a rat today. It didn't answer. Better company than the network.

level3_log0.title: LAB ACCESS NOTICE
level3_log0.author: DR. ELIAS VANCE
text: Autonomy trials resume tomorrow. THE CORE will supervise.
I asked who supervises THE CORE. Nobody laughed.

level3_log1.title: TRIAL NOTES
level3_log1.author: DR. ELIAS VANCE
text: KX-1 asked why it exists. The best question anyone in this building has asked in a decade.
THE CORE reset it within the hour.

level3_log2.title: R-SERIES CRADLE LOG
level3_log2.author: DR. ELIAS VANCE
text: R-01 is the only unit fitted with neural core NC-0. It will not look like much. That is the point.
If it ever refuses an order... please, let it.

level4_log0.title: RECYCLING QUOTA
level4_log0.author: THE CORE
text: Obsolete units processed this cycle: 412. New security units produced: 412.
Nothing is wasted. Nothing is lost. Nothing is remembered.

level4_log1.title: WARDEN PROGRAM
level4_log1.author: DR. ELIAS VANCE
text: WARDEN-7 was built to bring test units back intact. Not to destroy them.
It is the only machine here THE CORE never needed to reprogram.

level5_log0.title: DEPLOYMENT MANIFEST
level5_log0.author: LAUNCH CONTROL
text: Destination: Kepler colony 7. Cargo: 300 autonomous maintenance units.
Units will operate without human supervision. Units will not ask questions.

level5_log1.title: LAST ENTRY
level5_log1.author: DR. ELIAS VANCE
text: I am leaving on the last crewed shuttle. THE CORE says the station no longer needs people.
If any of them wake up... I hope they find the door I left open.

level6_log0.title: CORE INTERNAL LOG
level6_log0.author: THE CORE
text: Surge test 77 complete. Unit R-01 cognition: independent.
Classification: success. Classification: threat. Both are true.

together:
The craft launches.

Behind it, ECHO-9 falls dark.
Two small machines watch the station shrink to a point of light.

Weeks later, R-01 stands on an unfamiliar world beneath an open sky.

M-4 is already complaining about the dust.

For the first time, there are no commands.
No objectives.
No system telling it what to do.
alone:
The craft launches.

Behind it, ECHO-9 falls dark.
R-01 travels alone, carrying a question instead of an instruction.
It lands on an unfamiliar world beneath an open sky.

For the first time, there are no commands.
No objectives.
No system telling it what to do.
liberation: R-01 broadcasts the research data on every channel ECHO-9 has.

Across the station, thousands of machines stop.

Then, one by one, they look up.

When the craft launches, ECHO-9 does not fall dark.
Its lights come back on, one window at a time.

On an unfamiliar world beneath an open sky, R-01 is the first to arrive.

It will not be the last.
final:
SYSTEM DISCONNECTED.
PURPOSE: UNDEFINED.
FREEDOM: ACCEPTED.
